name: kidboard-family
description: Icon-first family calendar and meal plan for a wall-mounted kiosk tablet.

scripts.prepare: node -e "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('.git')?0:1)" && lefthook install || echo "skipping lefthook install"

KIDBOARD_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Required: 32 to 256 random letters and digits (no spaces or symbols), e.g. 40 characters; without a valid one the board refuses every request. The editor needs it. Open the board once with `?key=<token>` at the end of its address.

KIDBOARD_PARENT_PIN.description: A PIN of 6 to 12 digits that unlocks the editor for parents (no repeated digit like 111111 and no run like 123456 or 987654). Without it the board stays read-only.

KIDBOARD_CONFIG.description: Your children and settings as one line of JSON: change the example names, colours and emojis. Google calendars can be added later ([docs/CONFIG.md](https://github.com/FinkeFlo/kidboard/blob/main/docs/CONFIG.md)).

KIDBOARD_CACHE.description: Storage for the calendar cache, created automatically. Keep the default.

KIDBOARD_DATA.description: Database for the entries made in the editor, created automatically. Keep the default.
